label: D1 after reward, boosted by recent a1->S2 rare transitions (peak 2 trials back)
terms: (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * ((tv("action", -1) == 1) & (tv("state", -1) == 2)) ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * ((tv("action", -2) == 1) & (tv("state", -2) == 2)) ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * ((tv("action", -3) == 1) & (tv("state", -3) == 2)) ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * ((tv("action", -4) == 1) & (tv("state", -4) == 2)) ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 1)
explanation: Active only at D1 and only when the reward input is on (the previous trial was rewarded); about 0 after unrewarded trials and at GO/D2. Magnitude rises with recent a1->S2 (rare) transitions in the history: weights about +0.75 if the last trial was a1->S2 (rewarded), +1.5 if it happened 2 trials back, +0.8 at 3 back and +0.3 at 4 back. Ideal-observer belief log-odds that S1 is good adds a small positive graded effect (rewarded D1 only), and a1 two trials back without the S2 transition slightly lowers it. Plain choice history (a1 vs a2 lags) or state alone fit much worse (0.23); the a1-and-S2 conjunction is what matters. Big misses are first trials of a window (no visible history) and runs of a2 choices after a switch away from a1, where activation starts high and decays. Observed-only test R^2 beyond timing 0.44 (dev 0.45), about the profile all-observed reference 0.43 and 75% of the all ceiling 0.58. The model-policy decile alone gives 0.22, so the observed-only description loses little or nothing compared with using the model outputs.
